تتعاهدن (form VI)
# تَتَعَاهَدْنَ (tataʕāhadna) /ta.ta.ʕaː.had.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تُتَعَاهَدْنَ (tutaʕāhadna) /tu.ta.ʕaː.had.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
